subject: Following up from Inference at Scale — next steps?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Rao <nina@edgeai.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-22T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Following up from Inference at Scale — next steps?

Hi Nina — great meeting you at the Inference at Scale summit on Tuesday. I really enjoyed our conversation about EdgeAI's latency-sensitive recommendation use case and the multi-region deployment challenges you mentioned. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary need: sub-50ms tail latency for 512-token context across US + EU regions
- Constraints: strict data governance (SOC 2 + region isolation), predictable per-token costs, and a plan for bursty traffic during product launches
- Interest areas we discussed: Redwood Dedicated for reserved GPU capacity, automatic prefix caching, and private deployment options for regulated customers

I've attached a short deck that highlights a few customer patterns similar to yours (redwood-deck.pdf) and a SOC2 summary for compliance questions (soc2-summary.pdf). Suggested next steps:

1) 30-minute technical discovery with your infra/ML lead to map traffic patterns and sequence lengths
2) a pricing/commit walkthrough with procurement (we can send an initial committed-cost estimate)
3) share logs/samples later for perf validation (we can set up a limited benchmark)

Are you available for a 30-min call next week? I have the following windows (PST):
- Tue 9/28 10:00–11:00
- Wed 9/29 14:00–15:00
- Thu 9/30 08:30–09:30

If none of those work, tell me a couple times that do and I will coordinate. Thanks again for the time — happy to put a short mutual action plan together after the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-deck.pdf (12 slides, high-level architecture + case studies), soc2-summary.pdf (summary of controls and evidence we can share)
